## Overview



## 🎯 Learning objectives

By the end of this session, you should be able to:

- Write simple unit tests and understand why testing matters
- Handle environment variables and secrets securely
- Understand what CI/CD is and how automated testing can be incorporated into a workflow
- Understand the purpose of virtual environments such as {renv} and venv


## 📖 Before the session

Please complete the [pre-learning materials](pre-learning.qmd). These typically take 60 – 90 minutes and are essential for getting the most out of the session.
